items.title: Bespoke OLAP: Using AI to Synthesize Workload-Specific DBMS Engines from Scratch
items.raw_excerpt: Every modern OLAP engine pays a hidden performance tax: the cost of being general-purpose. What if we could let AI build a database engine for exactly your workload, from scratch, in a few hours? We introduce Bespoke OLAP, a fully autonomous synthesis pipeline that uses LLM-guided code generation to produce complete, workload-specific C++ database engines, achieving 11.78x total speedup over DuckDB on TPC-H.

title_i18n.en: Bespoke OLAP: Using AI to Synthesize Workload-Specific DBMS Engines from Scratch
title_i18n.zh: 定制OLAP：使用AI从零合成特定工作负载的数据库管理系统引擎
title_i18n.es: OLAP personalizado: Utilizando IA para sintetizar motores de bases de datos específicos de la carga de trabajo desde cero

excerpt_i18n.en: Every modern OLAP engine pays a hidden performance tax: the cost of being general-purpose. What if we could let AI build a database engine for exactly your workload, from scratch, in a few hours? We introduce Bespoke OLAP, a fully autonomous synthesis pipeline that uses LLM-guided code generation to produce complete, workload-specific C++ database engines, achieving 11.78x total speedup over DuckDB on TPC-H.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 每个现代OLAP引擎都支付了一笔隐性的性能税：通用性带来的成本。如果我们能让AI从零开始，在几小时内为你当前的工作负载构建一个数据库引擎会怎样？我们介绍Bespoke OLA。
excerpt_i18n.es: Cada motor OLAP moderno paga un impuesto oculto de rendimiento: el costo de ser de propósito general. ¿Y si pudiéramos dejar que la IA construyera un motor de base de datos específicamente para tu carga de trabajo, desde cero, en unas pocas horas? Presentamos Bespoke OLA.

items.title: Anyone else went through the AI-editor carousel back to the terminal?

Feels closer to pair programming than to orchestration or autocomplete. Current stack: - Ghostty (native splits, no multiplexer) + moonfly t

items.title: Research-Driven Agents: When an agent reads before it codes
items.raw_excerpt: Coding agents working from code alone generate shallow hypotheses. Adding a research phase — arxiv papers, competing forks, other backends — produced 5 kernel fusions that made llama.cpp CPU inference 15% faster.

title_i18n.en: Research-Driven Agents: When an agent reads before it codes
title_i18n.zh: 研究驱动的代理：当代理在编码前阅读
title_i18n.es: Agentes impulsados por la investigación: Cuando un agente lee antes de codificar

excerpt_i18n.en: Coding agents working from code alone generate shallow hypotheses. Adding a research phase — arxiv papers, competing forks, other backends — produced 5 kernel fusions that made llama.cpp CPU inference 15% faster.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 仅凭代码工作的编码人员会产生浅显的假设。增加研究阶段——包括arxiv论文、竞争分支、其他后端——产生了5种内核融合，使llama.cpp的CPU推理速度提高了15%。
excerpt_i18n.es: Los agentes de codificación que trabajan únicamente a partir del código generan hipótesis superficiales. Añadir una fase de investigación — artículos de arXiv, bifurcaciones competidoras, otros backends — produjo 5 fusiones de kernel que hicieron que la inferencia CPU de llama.cpp fuera un 15% más rápida.
